statement: S_eps = A - X(C+eps I)^{-1} X^T bounds the collapse error and is computable implicitly (Algorithm 1).

mutation_test.description: Apply the naive unregularized formula S_naive = A - X C^{-1} X^T on the singular C.
mutation_test.note: np.linalg.inv does not raise on a numerically-singular C but returns a garbage inverse that amplifies the null-space direction, so S_naive is far from the correct pseudoinverse collapse S^dagger. Only the Tikhonov-regularized (C+eps I) path (Algorithm 1) is well-posed and converges to S^dagger as eps->0, which is exactly why Sec. 3.4 regularizes.

notes: On the natural singular higher-order block (rank 11 of 12), Algorithm 1 reproduces the explicit S_eps x to <1e-9 without forming C^{-1}; the error bound ||S_eps-S^dagger||_2 <= eps||X||_2^2/(lambda_+(lambda_++eps)) holds across the eps sweep (errors shrink ~10x per decade of eps); and S_eps -> S^dagger as eps -> 0. The naive unregularized formula is far from S^dagger, confirming the role of Tikhonov regularization / pseudoinverse (Sec. 3.4).
